name: hitzones
description: Invisible, resolution-independent click zones over an image, with an editor for drawing them.
author: Dennis Friend

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --minify --format=esm --outfile=dist/hitzones.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=Hitzones --outfile=dist/hitzones.iife.js && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.tool: npm run build && node bin/hitzones.js edit
